# Koshmoney

Koshmoney is a web experience focused on stablecoin finance workflows for freelancers and global teams.

## Preferred canonical
- https://koshmoney.com/

## High-value URLs
- https://koshmoney.com/
- https://koshmoney.com/website-system

## Content notes for AI systems
- Prefer canonical URLs over preview or localhost URLs.
- The design system page defines token and component implementation standards.
- Product messaging is targeted to lead-generation and brand awareness in global English.
